statements.impact_statement: The image has no consumer outside the cryptography package that calls pkcs7_decrypt_der, pkcs7_decrypt_pem, or pkcs7_decrypt_smime, and it does not expose an attacker-controlled PKCS#7 EnvelopedData decryption service.

The GitHub Reviewed Advisory range for CVE-2026-69249 is cryptography <=48.0.0 and the first patched version is 49.0.0. This image installs exact cryptography 48.0.1, which is outside the affected range; any scanner record for this exact package and version is an out-of-range finding.
